title: Ummanu instance config
description: Top-level instance.yaml for a single ummanu installation.

name.description: Human name of this installation, e.g. 'ummanu-home'.

data_dir.description: Nonempty absolute or relative path to the ummanu-data directory. Relative paths are resolved from this instance.yaml.

offsite.description: Recovery-chain settings. The instance repo needs a private git remote off the VPS; it is the single recovery contract (docs/RECOVERY.md).

instance_remote.description: Private git remote URL for this instance repo.

snapshot_repo.description: Bare Git repository the snapshot exporter commits into (docs/RECOVERY.md, Writers). Relative paths are resolved from data_dir; absent means <data_dir>/backup/instance.git.

persona.description: Pointer to the installation persona. Rules live in persona/, not here.

heads.description: Model heads bound to orchestrator roles.

policies.description: Free-form installation policies rendered by reconcile.

open_sprint_limit.description: How many sprints this installation may hold open at once. Absent means 1, which is the singleton every installation has by default. 2 is the pilot, and admits a second open sprint only when it is disjoint from the first.

po.description: The PO head in the dashboard (/po).

models.description: Models a PO session may be opened with, per CLI. A CLI not named keeps the product default (claude: fable, claude-opus-5-5; codex: gpt-6-astra, gpt-6-sol, gpt-5.6-terra); an empty list offers that CLI no model.

efforts.description: Reasoning efforts a PO session may be opened with, per CLI (Claude --effort, Codex -c model_reasoning_effort=). The first entry per CLI is preselected. A CLI not named keeps the product default (claude: high, low, medium, xhigh, max; codex: high, low, medium, xhigh). A new session's effort is always explicit: `default` (no flag) is dropped from the list and never accepted for a new session; it is only the stored value of sessions opened before that rule.

host.description: Host ownership boundaries and inputs. Desired resources are derived by reconcile, not listed here.

projects_root.description: Directory on the host that holds project repos, enumerated to find repos not described here.

unit_prefix.description: systemd unit namespace ummanu manages, e.g. 'ummanu-'. Scopes which host units count as ours.

units.description: Units this installation claims on the host. Read by host.build_expectations, the expectation set the host inventory is collected against for 'reconcile plan'/'reconcile apply', the host step of upgrade and 'restore-reconcile'. A non-empty list makes the live collector require host.unit_prefix, since without a namespace to enumerate it cannot report unmanaged-on-host and refuses rather than emit a partial diff. The units the plan installs come from packaging/systemd and host.components, not from here; doctor derives its own parity from the plan (host.build_doctor_expectations) and does not read this field.

orca_repos.description: Legacy and ignored. Orca repo registrations are no longer part of the host surface: reconcile, the host step of upgrade, 'restore-reconcile' and doctor neither read this field nor create, check or remove Orca repos. Kept so existing instance files still validate.

components.description: Opt-outs from the shipped runtime components. A component absent here is enabled; the key is the packaged unit name minus host.unit_prefix and the unit suffix, e.g. 'curator' or 'steward-deep-sweep'.

web_front.description: The web-front component's own configuration. Instance config travels with the live root and the rendered Caddyfile under the data directory does not, so install, recover and upgrade render <data>/webfront/Caddyfile from here (docs/OPERATIONS.md, 'Web front sites').

sites.description: The https site addresses the front answers on, as `ummanu web-front render --site` takes them, e.g. https://host.example or https://203.0.113.7. Required when the web-front component is enabled on an installation that install or recover materializes.

foreign_units.description: Units under host.unit_prefix that this installation knows are owned by something else. Without an entry here an unrecognised unit in our namespace is a conflict and reconcile refuses to write.

memory_reindex_python.description: Deprecated compatibility path for an external memory rebuild Python.

memory_reindex_script.description: Deprecated compatibility path for an external reindex script.

memory_model.description: Embedding model for the ummanu-owned memory index.

memory_threads.description: Maximum ONNX Runtime inference threads for the memory embedding model. Defaults to 1 so one memory request does not monopolize the host.
